title: GTA6: Rockstar Visited Strip Clubs and Rode With Ex-Cops for Florida Research
description: GTA6 Hub reports on Rockstar Games' immersive research for GTA6, revealing developers visited Florida strip clubs and rode with ex-cops at night.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Uncovering the Real Florida: How Rockstar Researched GTA6

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the next chapter in the franchise, new details continue to emerge regarding the sheer scale of effort Rockstar Games is putting into the development of *GTA6*. According to a recent report by IGN Games, the studio went to remarkable lengths to secure first-hand, authentic experiences of real-life Florida to shape the game's world.

## Immersive Fieldwork: Strip Clubs and Night Patrols

Per the source material, Rockstar developers took a remarkably hands-on approach to their research. The studio's teams visited local strip clubs and even rode around at night alongside former police officers to gain an authentic, unfiltered look at Florida's nocturnal environment, culture, and street-level dynamics.

This level of ground-level investigation highlights Rockstar's commitment to capturing the true essence of its virtual settings. Rather than relying solely on satellite imagery or digital archives, the developers seemingly sought out the sights, sounds, and lived experiences that define the region.

## Context and Analysis

While the report from IGN Games is concise, it aligns with Rockstar Games' legendary development history. Past titles, such as *Grand Theft Auto V* and *Red Dead Redemption 2*, have heavily relied on deep geographic and cultural research to breathe life into their respective open worlds.

Industry analysts and fans alike note that this kind of immersive preparation is likely what allows Rockstar to craft such believable, reactive virtual ecosystems. By experiencing the real-life atmosphere of Florida firsthand—from its vibrant nightlife to its law enforcement dynamics—the development team is laying a robust foundation for the recreation of Vice City and its surrounding areas.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's dedication to field research underscores why the studio's open worlds stand out in the industry. Immersing developers directly into Florida's culture, nightlife, and security environment proves that authenticity remains the top priority for *GTA6*.
